parsed.basis: Ebon is covered by the Marshall Islands national regime, which has no criminalisation of consensual same-sex conduct, sets an equal age of consent, and under the 2019 Gender Equality Act prohibits discrimination on grounds of gender identity and sexual orientation across public and private spheres, with judicial conduct rules against bias. No region-specific information distinguishes Ebon from the national picture; there is no documented local exception, facility restriction, border practice, or pattern of police targeting, violence, or denied care specific to this atoll. A visitor discovered as transgender would therefore rely on the same national protections and general law-enforcement response as elsewhere in the country.
